Description: Select and navigate Codex CLI tasks through app-server: approvals, stop, new tasks, forks, saved prompts, steering, prompt shortcuts, next-prompt model settings, native goals, tokens and account usage. Requires a compatible app-server. Does not type into terminals.
Name: Codex CLI
